portraitBackgrounds.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, background outpainting.
Edit target: the one attached original portrait. This is a real person's photograph for a university team website.
Make a landscape canvas approximately 1.406:1 (the reference display size is 509 wide by 362 high). Preserve the ENTIRE original portrait, centered, at the full output-canvas height, with the exact same person, complete head, face, hair, glasses if present, expression, pose, body, clothing and all original foreground details. Extend the canvas ONLY to the left and right; do not crop, zoom in, replace the person, beautify, retouch the face, or add limbs. Add only a natural seamless continuation of the existing background into the new side areas. Continue the existing wooden bookshelves and softly lit academic office naturally to both sides.
No new people, no text, no logos, no borders, no graphical frames, no blur bars or mirrored copies of the person. The center original photograph must stay visually unchanged; all creative editing is restricted to added side background. Photorealistic continuity, natural lighting and perspective.
portraitBackgrounds.displayPolicy: Generated layer supplies added side background and a narrow edge blend. The unchanged original photograph remains a complete foreground layer; the face is not regenerated.
